door.town_hall_main.name: Town hall door
door.town_hall_main.description: The town hall's front door. It is tall, made of pale wood, with diamond-paned glass.
door.town_hall_main.time_refusal: The town hall only opens its doors between 8am and 8pm.
door.clock_tower_backdoor.name: clock tower back door
door.clock_tower_backdoor.description: An old service door whose metal parts wear a layer of ancient rust.
door.clock_tower_ladder.name: metal ladder
door.clock_tower_ladder.description: A tall aluminium-alloy ladder used to move between the levels of the clock tower. It looks old, but still sturdy.
entity.machine_1.name: machine
entity.machine_1.description: An electrical installation that vibrates, heats up and roars to do its job.
entity.weight_shaft.name: counterweight shaft
entity.weight_shaft.description: A thick steel cable vanishes into a vertical shaft, creeping slowly down into the depths of the tower in a series of jolts. Somewhere below, one senses the mass of a counterweight pulling it along.
entity.large_winding_mechanism.name: winding mechanism
entity.large_winding_mechanism.descripti: A squat mechanism hoists the counterweight in steady jerks, an arm lifting the load in a patient, endless motion. It is what keeps time from stopping.
entity.clock_tower_escapement.name: escapement
entity.clock_tower_escapement.descriptio: A heavy pendulum beats the measure, each swing releasing one notch of the mechanism with a deep click. This is the true heart of the tower's clockwork.
entity.clock_tower_mirror.name: wall mirror
entity.clock_tower_mirror.description: A large wall mirror that looks out of place here. Its surface is grimy and crossed with cracks.
door.clock_tower_magic_mirror.name: magic mirror
door.clock_tower_magic_mirror.descriptio: Despite the grime and cracks covering its surface, the mirror gives off an uneven silvery shimmer. It does not reflect the room you are standing in.
door.clock_tower_magic_mirror.pass_refus: The mirror sends back a reflection warped by grime, cracks and quicksilver light.
entity.miravi.name: miravi
entity.miravi.description: The shadow of a bird of prey whose skin gives off diffuse, crystalline glimmers. Its wingspan is as striking as the many sources of light that seem trapped in its body of glass.
entity.mirror_weight_shaft.name: inverted shaft
entity.mirror_weight_shaft.description: Strange, repulsive organic cables carry the heavy weights up towards a hole in the heights of the room, in a complete absence of logic.
entity.mirror_large_winding_mechanism.de: A mechanism that defies logic, its powerful arm pulling the huge weights downwards as if to tear them from the sky. It seems to be under phenomenal strain.
entity.mirror_clock_tower_escapement.des: Watching this pendulum's unnatural swing for too long slowly fills the mind with a terrible sense of doom.
entity.large_machinery.name: heavy machinery
entity.large_machinery.description: An imposing assembly of gears and other metal parts, tirelessly turning with a heavy sound.
entity.sound_emitter.name: sound emitter
entity.turret_clockwork.name: clock tower timer
entity.turret_clockwork.description: A huge electrical cabinet with a dial showing the time to the millisecond: {hour}:{minute}.
